changelog: Dust and cap bundle. (1) Bond sleeve arms k_per_allocation_pct: 10, which Preserve already had — Growth carried a sub-1% position in 29 of 248 reallocations against Preserve's 0, including three bond slivers under 1% each on 2024-02-01. (2) min_position_yields_to_breadth is replaced by min_position_breadth_pct: 6, a REDUCED floor rather than an off-switch: suppressing the floor entirely in crowd months also discarded the dust-trimming it exists for. (3) min_sleeve_pct: 2 sweeps a de-minimis sleeve budget UP rather than down, because routing a fraction of a percent toward safety publishes a risk decision we did not make. (4) dynamic_k and the per-sleeve floor now respect the per-fund cap when redistributing after a drop — they were rescaling survivors blindly and breaching the crowd-tightened cap in 4 of 248 months (ITA 53.02% against a 49.84% cap). CAGR 20.93% -> 20.99%, Martin 4.087 -> 4.098, worst-12mo -5.14% -> -5.31%, maxDD unchanged; cap violations 4 -> 0; sub-2% dust months 34 -> 8; trailing-12 holdings 6.00 -> 5.25. All four D6 instruments improve, including longest-underwater 1198d -> 913d. Breadth 6 deliberately sits below 21% CAGR: 4 and 5 clear it, but 5's margin is 0.002pp, inside one-day timing noise.
